orbwalker.title: Orbwalker
orbwalker.tooltip.still_combo: Attacks the normal Combo target while suppressing movement commands.
orbwalker.tooltip.freeze: Waits longer before taking a minion last hit, aiming to keep the wave from being pushed.
orbwalker.tooltip.extra_windup: Adds a safety delay after the attack cast time before movement is allowed.
orbwalker.tooltip.farm_delay: Offsets health prediction when deciding whether an auto attack will last-hit a minion.
orbwalker.tooltip.movement_delay: Minimum delay between MoveTo IssueOrder calls. Runtime timing is stored in seconds.
orbwalker.tooltip.focus_minions_objectiv: When enabled, Lane Clear attacks nearby lane minions before turrets, inhibitors or the nexus.
orbwalker.tooltip.missile_check: Allows movement as soon as the auto-attack missile has been confirmed as launched.
orbwalker.tooltip.hold_radius: Stops issuing movement orders while the cursor point is inside this radius around the player.
